_comment: RQ3 for Jessica at 0.3 m with the second pair: unit 3 in position A and unit 1 in position B (the first 0.3 m session used unit 1 in A and unit 2 in B). expected_range_mm is an angle table: 290 at 0 degrees, 300 at 12 (her first 0.3 m session rose 10.5 mm over 0 to 12 degrees). at tape 600 the new pair's mean is 570.25 against 568 for the first pair, so the 0.3 m mean should rise by about 2 mm from 288 to about 290.
